title: poa urssulensis subsp. krylovii
intro: Poa urssulensis subsp. krylovii, commonly known as Krylov's blue grass, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is native to Russia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Krylov's blue grass include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful for treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Krylov's blue grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
